sloka: ततस्ते प्रीतमनसः सर्वे वानरपुङ्गवाः ।हनूमन्तं महात्मानं परिवार्योपतस्थिरे ।परिवार्य च ते सर्वे परां प्रीतिमुपागताः ।। 5.57.32 ।।।।
transliteration: tataste prītamanasaḥ sarve vānarapuṅgavāḥ ।hanūmantaṁ mahātmānaṁ parivāryopatasthire ।parivārya ca te sarve parāṁ prītimupāgatāḥ ।। 5.57.32 ।।।।

translations.english: Feeling very happy at heart all the vanara leaders gathered around Hanuman. They stood motionless with extreme happiness.
